correctness.rationale: Pointwise Gaussian cone selection follows by an all-dimensional exact two-case proof on the top-r subset; Johnson independence ensures its second-best exchange is allowed. Conditional internal/external orderings are independent uniform, yielding 1/(Nrs) per adjacent forbidden subset. Johnson common-neighbor counts (four at distance two, zero at distance at least three) give the exact second moment. Grid matching proves sharp pointwise bounds. Brute-force exact optimization of seven n<=8 cases verifies the formulas but is not the universal proof.
